Create README.md

New UI - panels

As time flies, wide screen are the norm. Lets abuse them:

The new UI is split in half, in the left side you see the OCRed text,
and on the right the "source". In the future, I will be able to load
"pfd" (or whatever) and I will be able to paginate between the pages and
OCR "on the fly".

The PixmapViewer is now defined in the UI file, which simplified code a
little.

Fix main ui

 - The path to the resources was wrong, which caused icons to be
   invisible.
 - MainToolbar was disabled, which broke the ... well, application.
FAIL.

and new file.
